name: Georgia

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

policy_docs.title: Digital Services Georgia: 1.2 Digital Accessibility Standards

applies_to: State of Georgia digital properties managed by state entities: websites, web apps, mobile apps and other digital information.

deadlines.what: Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Accessibility statement on every website naming WCAG 2.1 AA (or link to Georgia.gov's policy)
Contact information for users who hit barriers
Internal or external audit at least every 36 months; first audit must be a manual audit by an external vendor
Fix audit findings within 9 months; audits must include manual testing
GTA may audit agencies to confirm testing and remediation
procurement: All solicitations and contracts for digital properties must require WCAG 2.1 AA and regular testing and remediation.
enforcement: Administrative: GTA may audit agencies; no statutory remedy found.
notes: The page title reads SM-19-002 but the URL and search results say SM-19-001; the issue/revision date was not confirmed (search says 2019-08-28). The standard cites GTA's PM-04-001 and PS-08-005, not a statute. No Georgia statute on digital accessibility found. office_url comes from search results and was not opened. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.
